{{Quote|A well-timed word can be just as effective as a well-placed knife.|Kavil Dorne|<ref name="Encyclopedia" />}}
'''Kavil Dorne'''<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Dorne family]],<ref name="Dorne" /> a prestigious military family in the society of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Kavil Dorne served as a [[Training officer/Legends|training officer]] for the Empire's [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] division.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kavil Dorne was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Dorne shares a surname and rank with [[Vasil Dorne]], a character from the accompanying [[Star Wars video games|video game]], [[BioWare]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' of [[2011]], who appears in the [[Cipher Nine|Imperial Agent]] storyline, but Vasil Dorne's dialogue does not include the quote from the ''Encyclopedia'',<ref name="Advanced">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|Advanced Training: Imperial Agent|Vaiken Spacedock}}</ref> and thus it is unclear whether the name "Kavil" was a misspelling or intended as a separate character.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
